_comment: Snapshots whose visible text differs between html/before (old code) and html/after, with the reason. Checked by tools/visible-text/check.mjs (Chrome, with each side's stylesheet). Paths are <song>/<layout>-<variant>.html.

changes.reason: Předehra:, Sloka 1:, Refrén:, Recitál: are section headers; before, the intro chords were paired with the text 'Sloka 1:'
'1. text' and 'R: text' start sections, a chord line directly above moves into them, not across a blank line or a comment
repeat counts are shown as the number (CSS adds ×) and repeat bars are drawn by CSS, also on chord-only lines whose chords are hidden
a hidden comment with chords ('# play [C] softly') is hidden whole; before, 'hide text' removed its text first and its chords stayed visible
a written-out repeated chorus stays a copy of the first one; before, 'hide repeated chord sequences' removed its chords first, so it became a new 'Chorus (2)'
Verse 1:, Verse 2: are section headers; before, 'Verse 2:' was swallowed by the chorus and repeated with it
KNOWN RISK: lyric lines 'Řekni:', '2. dubna…', 'B: …' now start sections
'Intro: C G Am F', 'Mezihra: [Am] [F]', 'R: C G' are headers with chords that transpose and hide; before, one block with chords as text
plain chords behind a header label ('Intro: C G Am F') are chords now: transposed, hidden with 'hide chords', kept with 'hide text'
KNOWN RISK: lowercase [a], [e7] are not chords any more, shown as literal text
Em7b5, A7#9, G7b9, C7#5 are chords; before, shown as text, survived 'hide chords', missing in 'hide text'
'hide text' used to remove text before '[C G Am]' was split into chords, so those chords were lost; now they are shown
trailing 2x/(2x)/x3 is shown as the number only (2), CSS adds the ×; repeat bars /: :/ and |: :| (also from the chord line) are empty elements, CSS draws ‖: :‖; legacy keeps both as written
'1. text' and 'R: text' start sections; before, the whole song was one block
tabs count to 8-column stops, chords land on the right syllable
